sentences.text: This book is interesting.
The student is reading a book.
There are five books in my bag.
My pen is blue.
Please give me your pen.
He writes a letter with a pen.
I am writing a letter to Grandfather.
A letter from my friend came today.
Mother reads the letter and smiles.
There are books on the table.
Put the food on the table.
This table is made of wood.
Grandfather sits on the chair.
This chair is broken, don't sit on it.
Bring a chair for the guest.
The baby is sleeping on the bed.
Make your bed in the morning.
My bed is near the window.
In the evening Mother lights the lamp.
Many lamps burn at Diwali.
The lamp was blown out by the wind.
It is ten o'clock by the clock.
Father gave me a new watch.
There is a clock on the wall.
The phone is ringing, please check.
I talk with Mother on the phone.
Where is my phone?
My brother works on the computer.
There are new computers at school.
I know how to use a computer.
There are books in my bag.
The bag is very heavy.
He carries the bag on his shoulder.
At Diwali we wear new clothes.
Mother is washing the clothes.
Whose is this red cloth?
Leave your shoes outside the temple.
My shoes are worn out.
Father is buying a new pair of shoes.
I cannot find my key.
Open the door with the key.
The key is on the table.
Fill the pot with water.
There is milk in the pot.
Wash the dishes after the meal.
Please give me a glass of water.
There is hot tea in the cup.
The glass fell on the floor and broke.
Mother serves the food on a plate.
The plate is empty, please give me more.
I wash my plate after eating.
The baby eats yogurt with a spoon.
Add sugar with a spoon.
Bring a spoon.
Mother cuts the fruit with a knife.
The knife is sharp, be careful.
Children don't play with knives.
She looks at her face in the mirror.
The mirror hangs on the wall.
The mirror is broken, walk carefully.
Take an umbrella in the rain.

words.gloss: in the rain; in the rainy season

sentences.text: My umbrella is black.
He came without his umbrella; he forgot it.
I don't have much money with me.
Knowledge is the best wealth.
He buys books with the money.
This costs ten rupees.
I have fifty rupees with me.

sentences.target: एकेन रूप्यकेण किम् अपि न लभ्यते।
sentences.text: You can't get anything for one rupee.
sentences.transliteration: ekena rūpyakeṇa kim api na labhyate.

sentences.text: The girl is drawing a picture.
There is a beautiful picture on the wall.
This is a picture of my grandfather.
The boys are playing with a ball.
The ball got stuck in the tree.
My ball is red.
The baby plays with a toy.
My uncle brings me a new toy.
Put the toys in the box.
Where is my comb?
She combs her hair with a comb.
Put the comb in the bag.
Wash your hands with soap.
Bring the soap for the bath.
This soap smells nice.
In summer the fan is always running.
Please turn on the fan.
Grandmother waves a hand fan.
Many vehicles move on the road.
Father goes to the office by car.
Our car is white.
I ride my bicycle to school.
My bicycle is new.
My brother is learning to ride a bicycle.
The boat moves on the river.
We cross the river by boat.
The fisherman's boat is small.
The plane flies in the sky.
We will go to Delhi by plane.
The baby laughs when it sees the plane.
Krishna was on Arjuna's chariot.
At the festival the god's chariot moves along the road.
Four horses pull the chariot.
The farmer takes grain to market in a cart.
Two bulls pull the cart.
There are vegetables in the cart.
I am thirsty, so I drink water.
Drink lots of water in summer.
The river water is clear.
Drink a glass of milk every day.
The cow gives milk.
Don't put sugar in the milk.
Don't waste food.
The farmer provides food for everyone.
After eating, he drinks water.
Mother is cooking rice.
I eat rice with dal.
The rice is hot.
Grandmother is making chapatis.
I eat two chapatis.
Eat the vegetables with a chapati.
Eat one fruit every day.
There are many fruits on the tree.
This fruit is ripe.
Mother brings vegetables from the market.
Green vegetables are good for health.
Which vegetable is cooked today?
Bees collect honey.
Honey is sweet.
Grandfather takes honey with warm water.
Put a little sugar in the tea.
The sugar has run out; bring some from the shop.
Ants come near the sugar.
There is no salt in the vegetables.
Salt is obtained from the sea.
One should not eat too much salt.
Spread ghee on the chapati.
Mother lights the lamp with ghee.
Cow's ghee is pure.
In summer yogurt is cooling.
I eat yogurt with rice.
Mother makes yogurt from milk.
I drink tea in the morning.
Please have some tea.
The tea is very hot.
The mango is the king of fruits.
We eat mangoes in summer.
This mango is sweet.
The monkey is eating a banana.
I eat a banana in the morning.
The bananas are yellow.
